title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how individuals adopt mask-wearing over time under peer influence, information exposure, and policy interventions.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Mask use decision influenced by observed adoption among social neighbors and conformity tendency.

interactions.name: information_diffusion
interactions.description: Beliefs and risk perception updated via media exposure and interpersonal sharing, including misinformation effects.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Mandates, penalties, and incentives alter compliance likelihood and behavior at locations.

interactions.name: location_entry_requirement
interactions.description: Locations requiring masks deny entry or penalize noncompliance based on enforcement strictness.

interactions.name: mask_supply_distribution
interactions.description: Supply chain makes masks available; individuals purchase or receive subsidized masks subject to stock and delays.

interactions.name: social_network_contact
interactions.description: Daily contacts within social networks and co-located contexts expose individuals to peer behavior and norms.

metrics.name: adoption_rate
metrics.description: Share of the population wearing masks at each timestep.

metrics.name: time_to_target_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until adoption rate reaches or exceeds a specified target (e.g., 80%).

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Average adoption over a specified steady-state window (e.g., last 30 days).

metrics.name: policy_effect_size
metrics.description: Difference in adoption with vs. without policy interventions, or pre-post mandate change.

metrics.name: inequality_in_adoption
metrics.description: Disparity of adoption across subgroups (e.g., income or education), measured by Gini or variance.

metrics.name: rmse_to_observed
metrics.description: RMSE between simulated and observed adoption time series when empirical data are available.

metrics.name: noncompliance_events
metrics.description: Count of enforcement-triggered noncompliance incidents at locations.

validation_criteria.name: population_accounting
validation_criteria.description: At every timestep, adopters + non-adopters equals total population; no negative counts.

validation_criteria.name: bounded_probabilities
validation_criteria.description: All decision probabilities and rates remain within [0,1].

validation_criteria.name: stability_window
validation_criteria.description: Change in adoption rate over the last 14 days is below epsilon (e.g., < 0.01) to indicate steady-state.

validation_criteria.name: replicate_consistency
validation_criteria.description: Across N stochastic runs (e.g., N=30), key metrics’ coefficient of variation stays below a threshold (e.g., < 0.1).
